description: With a test pack of shapeless recipes in the namespaces aaa, zzz, bbb, example and test that take the same grids as each other or as the special firework_rocket, seven grids at a crafting table and in the own window: the recipe first by the id's path, then its namespace makes the result (zzz:aaa_mix before aaa:zzz_mix, aaa:same_mix before bbb:same_mix, the special minecraft:firework_rocket before example:rocket, test:a_rocket before it); Circuit and both official servers give identical results
